_about: Public-domain William Sancroft (1617-1693), Archbishop of Canterbury and the first of the nonjuring bishops, for the Word Hoard: his Occasional Sermons (1694), Lex Ignea (1666), the 1678 sermon to the House of Peers, and his Familiar Letters (1757), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
